fusions.name: Broadside
fusions.desc: A heavy broadside that deals 16 damage and throws the target back 3 tiles. Its damage rises +10% per tile of distance you have travelled (max +50%).

fusions.name: Full Salvo
fusions.desc: Looses 3 cannonballs at once, spread apart, each dealing 20 damage and ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Press Gang
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 6 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 8 seconds. While it lasts, an escort of sailors fights beside you for 6 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fair Wind
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
